candidates.section: Flags of municipalities of Micronesia > Chuuk State
candidates.text: ! scope="row" | Link to file | | Flag of Fefen | A blue field containing a mura bird flanked by a torch and wokupuun club, surrounded by a circle of 24 stars representing the island's villages.

candidates.section: Flags of municipalities of Micronesia > Chuuk State
candidates.text: ! scope="row" | Link to file | | Flag of Fonoton | A white field with the municipal seal as the charge. The circular municipal seal displays an island, sunrise, three stars and palm leaves. Its inscriptions are the names of Fonoton and Chuuk State, the year 1992 commemorating its separation from the municipality of Weno, and a motto in the secret language reading , translatable as "Assembly of the Sovereign".

candidates.section: Flags of municipalities of Micronesia > Chuuk State
candidates.text: ! scope="row" | Link to file | | Flag of Houk | A blue field with the municipal seal. Below it is the motto "Prosperity Through Unity" in green capital letters.

candidates.section: Flags of municipalities of Micronesia > Chuuk State
candidates.text: ! scope="row" | Link to file | | Flag of Kuttu | A white flag with a seal as the charge.

candidates.section: Flags of municipalities of Micronesia > Chuuk State
candidates.text: ! scope="row" | Link to file | 6 June 2011 – present | Flag of Moch | A light blue field with the municipal seal as the charge. A column of three white five-pointed stars representing Moch's villages are to the , and a column of five representing its clans are to the .

candidates.section: Flags of municipalities of Micronesia > Chuuk State
candidates.text: ! scope="row" | Link to file | | Flag of Tonoas | A light blue vertical flag with a large, white five-pointed star. Above it is a green (Ptilinopus porphyraceus) carrying a streamer in its beak reading "" ("calling for the light to shine on the land"), which is a phrase in the secret language. Below the star the year 2002 is inscribed.

candidates.section: Flags of municipalities of Micronesia > Chuuk State
candidates.text: ! scope="row" | Link to file | 1993 – present | Flag of Tsis | A green field with an emblem in the charge.

candidates.section: Flags of municipalities of Micronesia > Chuuk State
candidates.text: ! scope="row" | Link to file | | Flag of Udot | A blue bordered and horizontally striped white flag with a white hoist side bearing a fish above a first fruits bowl, surrounded by ten stars in a ring.

candidates.section: Flags of municipalities of Micronesia > Chuuk State
candidates.text: ! scope="row" | | | Flag of Weno | A monochrome white circular emblem bearing fourteen stars and an illustration of Tonnachau Mountain upon a field described as both dark green and black. |}

candidates.section: Flags of municipalities of Micronesia > Kosrae
candidates.text: ! scope="row" | | | Flag of Tafunsak | A dark blue field with scene featuring a beach, aeroplane, traditional canoe and palm tree, overlayed with four dark blue stars to represent Tafunsak's hamlets, encompassed by an olive branch wreath.

candidates.section: Flags of municipalities of Micronesia > Kosrae
candidates.text: ! scope="row" | Link to file | | Flag of Utwe | A red-white-blue tricolor bearing a gray silhouette of a crab with an illustration of Mount Finkol and canoe racing within it, surrounded by three white stars, a black wreath and arched text reading "UTWE MUNICIPAL GOVERNMENT". The white stars and stripes represent Utwe's three groups: red for Gateway, white for N-One and blue for Centerpoint. |}

candidates.section: Flags of municipalities of Micronesia > Pohnpei State
candidates.text: ! scope="row" | Link to file | 2019 – present | Flag of Kapingamarangi | A blue and green vertical triband with an emblem in the charge consisting of a canoe, wreath and stars.

candidates.section: Flags of municipalities of Micronesia > Pohnpei State
candidates.text: ! scope="row" | | | Flag of Kitti | A white flag with three blue horizontal stripes, with a white canton bearing a red crescent surrounded by twelve red stars.

candidates.section: Flags of municipalities of Micronesia > Pohnpei State
candidates.text: ! scope="row" | | | Flag of Kolonia | A red-white-green triband with a blue canton containing seven white five-pointed stars.

candidates.section: Flags of municipalities of Micronesia > Pohnpei State
candidates.text: ! scope="row" | | | Flag of Madolenihmw | Six red horizontal stripes with thinner white stripes in between them, with a light blue canton bearing the municipal seal and bordered by white.

candidates.section: Flags of municipalities of Micronesia > Pohnpei State
candidates.text: ! scope="row" | | 2010 – present | Flag of Mwoakilloa | A horizontal triband, coloured orange, white and green from top to bottom, with a blue triangle representing the ocean bearing three white stars representing the Urak, Kahlap, and Manton islands on the hoist side.

candidates.section: Flags of municipalities of Micronesia > Pohnpei State
candidates.text: ! scope="row" | | | Flag of Nett | Nine stripes alternating between purple and white; in a light blue canton are nine white stars arranged in a circle.

candidates.section: Flags of municipalities of Micronesia > Pohnpei State
candidates.text: ! scope="row" | | | Flag of Nukuoro | A blue field with three white five-pointed stars arranged in a triangle.

candidates.section: Flags of municipalities of Micronesia > Pohnpei State
candidates.file: Flag of Pingelap, Phonpei, Federated States of Micronesia.png
candidates.text: ! scope="row" | | July 2003 – present | Flag of Pingelap | Four rows, yellow, blue, red, and white (from top to bottom), with an emblem in the canton. The four colours represent groups of Pingelapese people: yellow for Mweniap/Peisik, blue for Peraku/Namahl, red for Sakarkapw/Ihlong and white for Kakalia/Pelenkous.

candidates.section: Flags of municipalities of Micronesia > Pohnpei State
candidates.text: ! scope="row" | | | Flag of Sapwuahfik | A pentacolor striped flag with yellow, blue, white, red, and green from top to bottom. In a green canton, one large white five-pointed star and nine smaller ones arranged in an arc on its flyward side.

candidates.section: Flags of municipalities of Micronesia > Pohnpei State
candidates.text: ! scope="row" | | | Flag of Sokehs | A blue field with the municipal seal upon a yellow sun with five-pointed stars next to the tips of its rays.

candidates.section: Flags of municipalities of Micronesia > Pohnpei State
candidates.text: ! scope="row" | | | Flag of U | A wreath encompassing five white stars on a blue field. |}

candidates.section: Flags of villages of Micronesia > Chuuk State
